title: SideChat
description: Creates a client console / client terminal to monitor and respond to in-game Chat!
body:
Hi! Welcome to SideChat. I play on a LAN world with my brother often, and sometimes we ALT-Tab out of the game but still want an easy way to monitor chat; this was my solution.

Re-open the window with CTRL+ALT+SHIFT+L

Need to commission a mod? add me on discord: **jason13**

---

## Configuration (`sidechat.json`)

| Option        | Description                                           | Default |
|---------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|
| `enabled`     | Whether the mod should function at all                | `true`  |
| `fontStyle`   | `0` = PLAIN, `1` = BOLD, `2` = ITALIC                 | `0`     |
| `fontSize`    | Size of the terminal text                             | `12`    |
| `openEarly`   | Open the window as soon as the mod loads              | `true`  |
| `onlyInWorld` | Open/close the window based on whether you're in-game | `false` |
| `startWidth`  | Initial window width before resizing                  | `896`   |
| `startHeight` | Initial window height before resizing                 | `504`   |

---

## Terminal Commands

All commands are prefixed with `#/` (e.g. `#/stop`).

### Window

| Command       | Description               |
|---------------|---------------------------|
| `#/stop`      | Close the SideChat window |
| `#/stop game` | Close Minecraft entirely  |
| `#/close`     | Alias for `stop`          |
| `#/shutdown`  | Alias for `stop`          |

### Audio

| Command           | Description                  |
|-------------------|------------------------------|
| `#/mute`          | Set master volume to 0       |
| `#/mute <source>` | Mute a specific sound source |

**Sources:** `master` `music` `record` `weather` `block` `hostile` `neutral` `player` `ambient` `voice`

### Terminal Appearance

| Command            | Description                                              |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `#/font size <n>`  | Set terminal font size (e.g. `12`)                       |
| `#/font style <n>` | Set terminal font style: `0`=PLAIN, `1`=BOLD, `2`=ITALIC |

### Game Settings

| Command              | Values                      | Notes                                                        |
|----------------------|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| `#/gamma <n>`        | `0.0` – `1.0`               | Screen brightness. `0.0`=moody, `1.0`=bright. Default: `0.5` |
| `#/fov <n>`          | `30` – `110`                | Field of view. Default: `70`                                 |
| `#/render <n>`       | `2` – `32`                  | Render distance in chunks. Default: `10`                     |
| `#/fps <n>`          | `10` – `260`                | Framerate limit. `260`=unlimited                             |
| `#/narrator <mode>`  | `off` `all` `chat` `system` | Narrator mode                                                |
| `#/chat <mode>`      | `full` `system` `hidden`    | Chat visibility filter                                       |
| `#/graphics <mode>`  | `fast` `fancy` `fabulous`   | Graphics quality                                             |
| `#/particles <mode>` | `all` `decreased` `minimal` | Particle density                                             |
